==Usage==
*<code><nowiki>{{range|CIDR range}}</nowiki></code>. Example: <code><nowiki>{{range|195.93.0.0/16}}</nowiki></code> gives: {{range|195.93.0.0/16}}

Optional Parameters:
*substring=''ip_fragment'': searches for a substring, handy for finding active individual blocks in a range. Example: <code><nowiki>{{range|195.93.0.0/16|substring=195.93.}}</nowiki></code>
*reason=''block reason'': allows you to specify a block reason, handy for large lists. Example: <code><nowiki>{{range|195.93.0.0/16|reason=AOL temporary range block}}</nowiki></code>
